harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the authoritative/forwarding DNS resolver for the shared private network (10.100.234.0/24): it answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.234.11) via a static-host-mapping, and forwards all other queries to upstream resolvers (1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9) via pdns_recursor. Configured node2 and node3 (Ubuntu 16.04) to resolve through node1 by fixing systemd-networkd's DHCP-pushed DNS (which was overriding resolv.conf via the platform's 50-antrieb-dhcp.network file) with DNS=10.100.234.10 / UseDNS=false, backing up the original, plus a resolvconf head entry and dhclient supersede directive for defense in depth. Verified inventory.internal and external names (example.com, cloudflare.com) resolve correctly from both client nodes. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id and DNS health, issued native reboots, polled until each node's exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified DNS forwarding/resolution and config persistence (VyOS config.boot, Ubuntu network files) after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (VyOS), node2 and node3 (Ubuntu 16.04) network/DNS baseline state

Configured VyOS node1: static-host-mapping inventory.internal -> 10.100.234.11, service dns forwarding listen-address 10.100.234.10, allow-from 10.100.234.0/24, upstream name-servers 1.1.1.1/9.9.9.9; committed and saved
Verified pdns_recursor active and listening on 10.100.234.10:53; dig confirmed inventory.internal and example.com resolution

Diagnosed node2/node3 DNS override conflicts: systemd 229 does not support .network.d drop-ins, and platform-managed 50-antrieb-dhcp.network was pushing DHCP-supplied DNS (10.100.234.1) over resolvconf
Backed up and edited /etc/systemd/network/50-antrieb-dhcp.network on node2/node3 to add DNS=10.100.234.10 and UseDNS=false
Added dhclient.conf supersede directive and resolvconf head file (nameserver 10.100.234.10) on node2/node3 as additional persistence/ordering guarantees
Verified getent/dig resolution of inventory.internal (to node2 IP) and external domains from node2 and node3
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, DNS service/resolution state) on all three nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until exec access returned, confirmed new boot_id, re-verified pdns_recursor active, config.boot persistence, and DNS resolution
Rebooted node2, polled until exec access returned, confirmed new boot_id, re-verified /etc/resolv.conf and inventory.internal/cloudflare.com resolution
Rebooted node3, polled until exec access returned, confirmed new boot_id, re-verified /etc/resolv.conf and inventory.internal/cloudflare.com resolution
